summary: Executed backend pytest regression and frontend Playwright integration checks for WEARHOUSE 60 rebrand, cart, admin stock, checkout redirect, payment status pages, and responsive behavior.

integration_issues.flow: Real Stripe end-to-end payment completion with card 4242
integration_issues.issue: Could validate checkout session creation and Stripe redirect with visible 99,99 amount, but full hosted checkout card submission was not completed in this automated run (Stripe hosted form/iframe interaction limitation in this pass).

action_items: Perform one manual Stripe sandbox payment on hosted checkout (4242) to conclusively validate post-payment redirect/confirmation UX.
If strict QA requires automation for full Stripe card submission, add a dedicated Stripe-hosted-flow strategy (stable test hooks or manual gate) since hosted fields can be brittle across runs.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py uses ADMIN_PASSWORD fallback default ('admin'); prefer fail-fast required env for production-safety and to avoid accidental weak admin auth.
frontend admin token localStorage key remains legacy name 'wax001_admin'; functionally OK but consider renaming for consistency with wearhouse60 naming.
seed_data_creation: Created test checkout/orders via API and one paid state via signed webhook simulation; inventory restored to 17/17/16 at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend critical regressions pass (11/11). Frontend verified: French rebrand, single product data, gallery prev/next/thumbs, size 1/2/3 behavior, add-to-cart disabled-before-size, in-cart stock depletion messaging, cart persistence, cancel keeps cart, admin login/stock save persistence and total 50, unauthorized admin returns 401, responsive widths (320/768/1024/1440) showed no horizontal overflow, screenshots captured at 1920x800 and 390x844. Remaining gap: complete an actual hosted Stripe payment submission with card 4242 and confirm paid UI path end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Unresolved gap is not backend logic: checkout session and status endpoints work, and webhook idempotency/one-time stock decrement passed in pytest. The missing proof is hosted Stripe form completion in this automation pass due Stripe-hosted input handling brittleness; requires manual validation or dedicated robust Stripe-UI automation setup.
